headline: Stlican Shelf and Fisherman's Row Erupt in Heavy Base Clashes
war_summary: Since our previous dispatch, the focal points of territorial combat have shifted sharply eastward and toward the coast, led by rapid base exchanges across Stlican Shelf and Fisherman's Row. In Stlican Shelf, six fresh base actions over the last two hours have left two strategic positions shattered in no-man's-land amid fierce clashes over The Old Mourn and Vulpine Watch. Simultaneously, Fisherman's Row erupted with six rapid base transfers across Arcadia and Eidolo, consolidating Warden control over the islands. Combat along the northern and central fronts remains intense; Callahan's Passage absorbed over thirteen hundred combined casualties in two hours alongside base turnover at The Latch and The Procession, while Weathered Expanse and Marban Hollow registered further fighting at Spirit Watch and Mox. Conversely, the volatile base flipping reported earlier in the Dead Lands and Stonecradle has subsided into steady positional attrition, with no strategic bases changing hands in either sector over the past two hours.
